title: Extract invoice date into Invoice Date field and recover due date fro…
summary: Invoice Date is now extracted and populated in the purchase draft, and Due Date can be recovered from payment terms when not at the top level in electronic documents.
key_points: Invoice Date field is mapped from extracted invoice date in both ADI and MLLM readers
Due Date fallback added to check payment_means.payment_due_date when top level due date is missing
MLLM schema extended with payment_due_date slot for the model
Document Date mapping remains unchanged, no downstream impact
Change is additive and low risk
quote: This maps the extracted date into Invoice Date too, in both the ADI and the MLLM readers, so it is no longer empty.
